# katello

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Katello adds Content and Subscription Management to Foreman. For this it relies on Candlepin and Pulp.

## 官网

- 主页: http://www.katello.org
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/Katello/katello
- 文档: http://katello.github.io/katello/
- 问题追踪: http://projects.theforeman.org/projects/katello
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/katello
